subject: general
question: Which of the following industries does NOT use washing soda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cosmetic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Washing soda, also known as sodium carbonate (Na2CO3), is used to reduce water hardness, but is not used directly to disinfect water.
 
• **Sodium carbonate**, sometimes known as washing soda, is a chemical compound having the formula Na₂CO₃ .
 
• It is a **carbonic acid** salt.
 
• It **irritates the respiratory tract **and can lead to coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath, searing sensation in the nose and throat, and other respiratory symptoms.
 
• When** skin** comes into touch with sodium carbonate, it can irritate, **blister, and burn,** especially if the skin is wet.
 
• When it comes into contact with the **eyes**, it can cause **destruction of cornea** as well as conjunctival edema, or swelling.
 
• These are the reasons why washing soda is **not used in cosmetic industries**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Features of a washing soda:

 
• It is a **crystalline solid** that is translucent.
 
• With a pH of 11, it is alkaline and changes red litmus to blue.
 
• It may eliminate filth, hence it has **detergent or cleansing** characteristics and oil from soiled clothing, etc.
 
• It breaks down oil and debris into water-soluble byproducts, which are subsequently removed with a water rinse.
 
• It is utilized in the paper, soap, and **glass industries**.
